warning: This is not a permission grant. Do not copy it to media_permissions until the owner supplies source-specific evidence and scope.
mandatory_limits: Permission applies only to posts authored by the registered handle.
Retweets, quotes, reposts and third-party authors never inherit permission.
No permission is inferred from public availability.

exact_post_permission_limits.authority: live media_permissions row after owner approval

golden_steps: Owner selects at least one registered X source for each managed account and supplies source-specific permission evidence.
Create a live media_permissions row with approved rights, account scope, operation flags, evidence, approver and approval timestamp; do not infer any field.
Read the permission row back and require the exact source_id, registered handle and target account to match.
Run bounded gallery-dl metadata discovery and reject profile URLs, non-status URLs, retweets, quotes and author mismatches.
Select one exact individual /status/ URL for each account and verify that its author is the registered source handle.
Run yt-dlp physical acquisition only behind the explicit download environment and confirmation gates.
Require ffprobe video/audio stream evidence, preserve_source geometry and content-hash provenance.
Stop at WAITING_REVIEW; do not publish to X or Threads as part of the Golden acquisition proof.
